title: The Panel With No Shadow
real_world_anchor: Original comic-style structure for testing without copyrighted characters.
script: The hero thought the villain was hiding in the smoke. Every panel showed broken glass, falling sparks, and one empty rooftop. Then the artist did something strange. In panel four, the hero had no shadow. That was the clue. The villain was not behind him. The villain had stolen the light itself. When the final panel went completely black, the speech bubble said only one thing: 'Now you can hear me.'
hook_first_sentence: The hero thought the villain was hiding in the smoke.
twist_line: The villain had stolen the light itself.
retention_hook: In panel four, the hero had no shadow.
facts: End with a short speech bubble.
why_it_worked: It makes the viewer inspect a visual clue, then turns that clue into the twist.
what_to_improve: Keep names generic to avoid brand/IP confusion.
